altText: AI-generated fashion editorial of four adult women sitting at varied heights on cushioned wooden seating beside turquoise tidal channels and pale desert dunes. The woman on the left and the blonde woman beside her smile and clasp hands. Three wear green-and-red crescent-and-star mini dresses; the fourth wears a copper beaded mini. Their footwear includes green pumps, rainbow platforms, a blue star-marked sandal and copper knee-high boots.
